messages.author: 6a57e947fbbd7d3f
messages.subject: loading plyr in R
parts:
Hi
I just became a member of this site.

I have a problem loading the package "plyr" in R. I manually installed
the package "plyr 1.6" into the directory "/~R/library". I believe
that I use R 2.13.1

My code is:
> .libPaths("~/R/library")
> ibrary(plyr)

I get the message:
Error in library(plyr) : 'plyr' is not a valid installed package

It works fine with other packages ("chron", "zoo", "ismev",
"Lmoments"), but not for the "plyr" package, and I have no idea what
is goin on. I have tried installing and loading earlier versions of
"plyr", but with the same result.

I appreciate any help a lot since I am stuck. Regards Sisse

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: loading plyr in R
parts:
I'd suggest installing plyr with install.packages("plyr") - manual
installation is not a good idea.
Hadley
